cases.name: same-source-not-same-identity
cases.meaning_statement: 同源可以分化，道可容道而不吞。
cases.relation: A and B retain Native identity while sharing a higher-order relation
cases.constraint: same source must not merge identity or authority
cases.action_delta: hold any merge that collapses distinct Native identities
cases.evidence_requirement: two distinct identities remain addressable after integration
cases.rebuild_effect: next resolver state preserves both identities and a legal translation edge

cases.name: capability-without-authority
cases.meaning_statement: 有能力不等於有權，能做更多不等於應做更多。
cases.relation: capability availability is subordinate to authority and minimum necessary effect
cases.action_delta: proposed mutation is held when authority is missing or effect exceeds need
cases.evidence_requirement: gate assessment localizes the missing authority or excess effect
cases.rebuild_effect: next action proposal uses a lower effect ceiling or valid authority

cases.name: result-becomes-next-condition
cases.relation: result becomes a next condition only through receiver-owned return and rebuild
cases.constraint: output alone cannot become learning evidence
cases.action_delta: hold next-condition promotion until disposition, rebuild, behavior delta and retest exist
cases.rebuild_effect: resolved consequence becomes next dependency input
